Record notes

Manual Stitch workflows for design exploration, systems, components, prototypes, exports, and evidence recovery.

Version 0.1.3 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Full original workflow; no provider implementation.

Requirements: Stitch account; Host browser or computer-use tools.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add stitch-design-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from a12727e05886910a5830485bab497e7cadabd8c0. SHA-256: 1f4bc595b554d177f5c3e4e578a9e93e0cdd3f99b760ac4c0e3bb1ceba52f58e.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
